# 7. Narrative, Setting and Atmosphere

7.1 Locked Setting Direction
- Napoleonic-era France with a Gothic mansion or castle as the primary environment.
- Period-compatible flintlock firearms, loose gunpowder, silverware, jewelry, perfume, cologne and absinthe support both fiction and mechanics.
- The architecture should plausibly contain residential, public, service, military, medical, exterior and burial spaces selected from the approved location pool.

7.2 Narrative Framework - To Be Crafted TBD The protagonist, reason for entering or becoming trapped, identity/origin of the werewolf, purpose of the major puzzles, safe-haven fiction, and final outcome have not been authored yet. Narrative question Required design outcome Who is the protagonist? Explains period-appropriate firearm handling, motivation, knowledge and emotional stakes without demanding excessive exposition. Why can the player not leave? Creates the initial escape problem and gives the major puzzles a coherent shared purpose. Why is the werewolf trapped here? Supports its access to all zones and its inability to leave or cross water. Why are safe havens protected? Provides a consistent reason the werewolf cannot enter and avoids arbitrary game-only rooms. What do the puzzles accomplish? Each area objective contributes to opening, powering, revealing or reaching the final escape route. What does escape mean? Resolves the mechanical objective and clarifies whether the werewolf remains contained, follows, or is separated by water.

7.3 Atmosphere and Environmental Storytelling Layer Direction Lighting Low-light Gothic mood with readable navigation, interactables and attack telegraphs. Darkness cannot be the sole source of difficulty. Soundscape Directional movement, breathing, claws, doors, distant activity and intentional silence communicate location and threat state. Werewolf presentation Partial sightings, silhouette, posture and sound preserve mystery while maintaining readable pounce, charge, stagger and recovery cues. Environmental storytelling Room condition, abandoned preparations, consumed resources, barricades, medical evidence and personal possessions suggest prior events and puzzle logic. v0.2 | CONCEPT / PRE-PRODUCTION | PAGE 10 Layer Direction Music Restrained; supports major escalation and relief without replacing spatial audio used for gameplay.
